data_dictionary.none_state: NONE means the strategic base is destroyed or demolished and has not been rebuilt by either faction; it is effectively no-man's-land.
data_dictionary.rate_trends: Adjacent equal-window comparison. Array order is [recent_per_hour, previous_per_hour, change_per_hour, direction].
data_dictionary.recent_events: A direct ownership flip can produce a loss row plus a capture row for the same state transition.
data_dictionary.selected_metrics: Evidence citation keys whose values and observation times are frozen at prediction time.
data_dictionary.total_enlistments: Cumulative unique players who have deployed to this region during the war. A player can count in multiple regions. This is not current population or a faction split; its change is only a new-to-that-region activity proxy.

previous_model_summary.war_summary: War 139 is on day 125 with no winner. Colonials hold a dominant strategic position with approximately 200 bases to Wardens' 60 across 40 regions. The most intense combat zones are Clahstra, Endless Shore, Callahans Passage, Marban Hollow, Onyx, and Speaking Woods, where both factions are sustaining heavy casualties with accelerating trends and active base flipping. Clahstra shows the highest recent intensity (2,000+ casualties/hr per side) with 18 events/24h across 3 active bases and a latest event at 20:46 UTC. Endless Shore follows with 1,800+ casualties/hr per side and 38 events/24h across 5 active bases, latest event at 19:48 UTC. Callahans Passage has 1,500+ casualties/hr per side with 5 events/24h across 2 active bases, latest event at 16:16 UTC. Marban Hollow has surged to 1,300+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 10 events/24h, latest event at 19:03 UTC. Onyx shows 2,600+ casualties/hr per side with accelerating trends and 10 events/24h, latest event at 20:31 UTC. Speaking Woods has 2,100+ casualties/hr per side with 7 events/24h, latest event at 20:16 UTC. Wardens hold quiet northern regions (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead, Howl County, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Reaching Trail) but face heavy pressure in Speaking Woods. Large Colonial rear areas (Deadlands, Drowned Vale, Allods Bight, etc.) are quiet with minimal casualties.
